title: ShieldCare Cover Limits, Claim Counts and the Customer's Excess
content:
## Limits schedule for Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans

Four ceilings and one customer contribution are set on each plan: what the plan will pay
across the whole term, the most it will pay on one claim, the number of claims it will pay
in one term, the most the retailer pays across every plan one customer holds in a rolling
twelve months, and the deductible, the amount the customer pays toward an approved claim.

| Plan | Term cover, USD | Most on one claim, USD | Claims paid in one term | Rolling twelve-month ceiling across the customer's plans, USD | Deductible, the customer's excess, USD | Deductible waived on a repair |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | 1500.00 | 750.00 | 2 | 3000.00 | 0.00 | yes |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | 2500.00 | 1200.00 | 3 | 5000.00 | 49.00 | no |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | 4000.00 | 2000.00 | 4 | 9000.00 | 99.00 | yes |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | 12000.00 | 6000.00 | 5 | 20000.00 | 149.00 | yes |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | 6500.00 | 3500.00 | 4 | 12000.00 | 75.00 | no |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | 45000.00 | 9000.00 | 24 | 90000.00 | 125.00 | yes |

### Reinstatement of the term cover

| Plan | Cover put back at each anniversary | On what basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour | no | not applicable |
| ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus | no | not applicable |
| ShieldCare Total Device Protection | yes | the full term limit at each coverage anniversary |
| ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium | no | not applicable |
| ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service | yes | the full term limit at each coverage anniversary |
| ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | yes | the full term limit at each coverage anniversary |

### Points of judgement on the schedule

The term cover and the per-claim ceiling are different figures and the lower of them binds
first: on ShieldCare Home Theatre Premium a single claim never draws more than 6000.00
however much of the 12000.00 term cover is untouched. ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour
carries a deductible of 0.00, so nothing is asked of the customer on a claim under that plan
whatever the form of settlement. The deductible is waived on a claim settled by repair on
ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour, ShieldCare Total Device Protection, ShieldCare Home
Theatre Premium and ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection; on ShieldCare Accidental Damage
Plus and ShieldCare Major Appliance Extended Service it is not waived on a repair.
